body: I can't bear to see this happen again, not knowing how long it will last. I close my eyes for a moment, taking deep breaths to gather strength. When I open them, I spot two children standing at the edge of the empty case, their faces filled with fear and confusion. They look up at me, hoping I understand. With a nod, they step forward, each one gripping tightly onto either side of the case as if to protect it from an invisible threat.
